title: A Novel SXXLF Motif in the FXR N-Terminal Domain Mediates Coregulator and Interdomain Interactions.
authors: Villalona, Priscilla; Pulahinge, Thilini; Yu, Tracy; Wenning, Jordan; Khan, Sabab Hasan; Frisbie, Crawford Joseph; Magafas, Jill; Barbe, Addison; Okafor, C Denise
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和突变实验研究FXR核受体NTD中SXXLF基序介导的共调节因子及结构域间互作，属广义蛋白-DNA转录调控相关但非直接TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移。
abstract: The nuclear receptor (NR) superfamily is comprised of ligand-regulated transcription factors that contain an intrinsically disordered domain at the amino-terminal end, known as the N-terminal domain (NTD). While this poorly conserved domain is known to possess ligand-independent activation function (AF-1), few NTD functions are conserved between NRs. Identified roles in other receptors include androgen receptor (AR), estrogen receptor (ER), and mineralocorticoid receptor (MR). Here, we aim to define the function of the NTD of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR), a crucial regulator of lipid and bile acid metabolism. We show that the NTD engages in interdomain contact with other FXR domains. We also observe that the NTD interacts directly with coregulator proteins. Using mutagenesis, mammalian two-hybrid assays, mammalian one-hybrid assay, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, we identify and validate a novel SXXLF motif in the NTD which mediates interactions with both coregulators and the ligand binding domain. Mutation of the motif induces large changes in conformational and allosteric coupling in FXR. Our study identifies a new nuclear receptor-interacting motif that modulates the transcriptional activity of FXR.
abstract_zh: 核受体（NR）超家族由配体调控的转录因子组成，其氨基末端包含一个内在无序结构域，称为N端结构域（NTD）。尽管已知这一保守性较差的结构域具有不依赖配体的激活功能（AF-1），但很少有NTD功能在核受体之间是保守的。在其他受体中已鉴定的作用包括雄激素受体（AR）、雌激素受体（ER）和盐皮质激素受体（MR）。在此，我们旨在定义法尼醇X受体（FXR）NTD的功能，FXR是脂质和胆汁酸代谢的关键调控因子。我们表明，NTD与其他FXR结构域发生结构域间接触。我们还观察到，NTD直接与辅调节蛋白相互作用。通过诱变、哺乳动物双杂交实验、哺乳动物单杂交实验和分子动力学（MD）模拟，我们鉴定并验证了NTD中一个新的SXXLF基序，该基序介导与辅调节因子和配体结合结构域的相互作用。该基序的突变诱导FXR构象和变构偶联发生重大变化。我们的研究识别了一个新的核受体相互作用基序，该基序调节FXR的转录活性。
